name: ross
description: Behavioral governance for explicit authority, minimum sufficient execution, evidence-backed completion, and disciplined use of context and compute.

interface.longDescription: ROSS — Reliable Operating Super Skill helps AI agents define authority before acting, choose the smallest sufficient path, verify completion against evidence, manage context deliberately, recognize security boundaries, conserve compute and cost, and stop when the requested outcome is complete. It is a behavioral governance skill that coexists with specialist skills. It does not replace platform permissions, identity, sandboxing, application authorization, or specialist expertise.
capabilities: Stop when the requested outcome is verified
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this failing test, fix only the verified cause, preserve unrelated changes, and show targeted proof.
Research this decision using current primary sources, separate facts from unknowns, and stop when evidence is sufficient.
Continue from the verified checkpoint, use the relevant specialist skill, and ask before any unapproved external action.
